arguments.statement: open KdVPlan in ∀ s r : ℝ, ∀ A : Coeff → Coeff, ∀ guard : Coeff → Prop, (∀ f, MemH s f → guard f → MemH r (A f)) → (∀ f, MemH s f → guard f → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ g, MemH s g → guard g → hn s (g-f) ≤ 1 → hn r (A g-A f) ≤ C*hn s (g-f)) → ContinuousMapH s r A guard
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro s r A guard hmem hbound f hf hgf
  refine ⟨hmem f hf hgf, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hb⟩ := hbound f hf hgf
  refine ⟨min 1 (ε/(C+1)), lt_min zero_lt_one (div_pos hε (by linarith)), ?_⟩
  intro g hg hgg hd
  have hd1 : hn s (g-f) ≤ 1 := (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_left _ _)).le
  have hd2 := lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_right 1 (ε/(C+1)))
  have hd3 : (C+1)*hn s (g-f) < ε := by
    have h := (lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0<C+1)).mp hd2
    simpa [mul_comm] using h
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ hn s (g-f) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have := hb g hg hgg hd1
  nlinarith)

const r=JSON.parse(await tools.check_auxiliary({statement:"open KdVPlan in (∀ s : ℝ, ∀ f : Coeff, MemH s f → HB s (invD f) (hn s f)) ∧ (∀ f g : Coeff, invD (f-g)=invD f-invD g) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, ∀ f g : Coeff, S t (f-g)=S t f-S t g) ∧ (∀ f g : Coeff, P (f-g)=P f-P g)",proof:"exact (open KdVPlan in by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s f hf
    have he : invD f = fun k => (if k=0 then (0:ℂ) else (Complex.I*(k:ℂ))⁻¹)*f k := by funext k; by_cases hk:k=0 <;> simp [invD,hk]
    rw [he]
    have hm : ∀ k : ℤ, ‖(if k=0 then (0:ℂ) else (Complex.I*(k:ℂ))⁻¹)‖ ≤ 1 := by
      intro k
      split_ifs with hk
      · simp
      · have hh : (1:ℝ) ≤ |(k:ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hk
        rw [norm_inv, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, one_mul]
        have hn : ‖(k:ℂ)‖ = |(k:ℝ)| := by simpa using Complex.norm_real (k:ℝ)
        rw [hn]
        exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hh
    simpa using (@yui_aux_0006 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 s _ 1 (by norm_num) hm f hf)
  · intro f g; funext k; by_cases hk:k=0 <;> simp [invD,hk,mul_sub]
  · intro t f g; funext k; simp [S,mul_sub]
  · intro f g; funext k; by_cases hk:k=0 <;> simp [P,hk])"}));text({candidate:r.candidate,accepted:r.accepted,helper:r.helper,diagnostic:r.accepted?undefined:r.stdout.slice(r.stdout.indexOf("error"))});

const r=JSON.parse(await tools.check_auxiliary({statement:"open KdVPlan in (∀ s r q : ℝ, ∀ A B : Coeff → Coeff, ∀ G H : Coeff → Prop, ContinuousMapH s r A G → ContinuousMapH r q B H → (∀ f, MemH s f → G f → H (A f)) → ContinuousMapH s q (fun f => B (A f)) G) ∧ (∀ s r : ℝ, ∀ A : Coeff → Coeff, ∀ G H : Coeff → Prop, ContinuousMapH s r A G → (∀ f, H f → G f) → ContinuousMapH s r A H)",proof:"exact (open KdVPlan in by
  constructor
  · intro s r q A B G H hA hB hguard f hf hgf
    have hAf := hA f hf hgf
    have hBf := hB (A f) hAf.1 (hguard f hf hgf)
    refine ⟨hBf.1, ?_⟩
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hδspec⟩ := hBf.2 ε hε
    obtain ⟨η,hη,hηspec⟩ := hAf.2 δ hδ
    refine ⟨η,hη,?_⟩
    intro g hg hgg hdist
    exact hδspec (A g) (hA g hg hgg).1 (hguard g hg hgg) (hηspec g hg hgg hdist)
  · intro s r A G H hA hguard f hf hgf
    have hf' := hA f hf (hguard f hgf)
    refine ⟨hf'.1, ?_⟩

  have hcore : ∀ D : Coeff → Coeff, ContinuousMapH s r D G → ContinuousMapH s r (fun f => A f+D f) G := by

    obtain ⟨η,hη,hηspec⟩ := hDf.2 (ε/2) (by positivity)
    refine ⟨min δ η, lt_min hδ hη, ?_⟩
    intro g hg hgg hd
    have h1 := hδspec g hg hgg (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_left _ _))
    have h2 := hηspec g hg hgg (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_right _ _))
    have hmA := (@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 r).2.2.1 _ _ (hA g hg hgg).1 hAf.1
    have hmD := (@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 r).2.2.1 _ _ (hD g hg hgg).1 hDf.1
    have he : A g+D g-(A f+D f)=(A g-A f)+(D g-D f) := by abel
    rw [he]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (@yui_aux_0002 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 r _ _ hmA.1 hmD.1).2 (by linarith)
  refine ⟨hcore B hB, ?_⟩

    intro f hf hgf
    have hf' := hB f hf hgf
    refine ⟨((@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 r).2.1 _ hf'.1).1, ?_⟩
    intro ε hε

let A:=C*(u+v+1)+1
have hA : 0<A := by dsimp [A]; positivity
refine ⟨min 1 (ε/(2*A)), lt_min zero_lt_one (div_pos hε (by positivity)), ?_⟩
intro x y z hx hy hz hxd hyd hzle

have hy1 : y<ε/(2*A) := lt_of_lt_of_le hyd (min_le_right _ _)

have hax : A*x<ε/2 := by have h:= (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<2*A)).mp hx1; nlinarith
have hay : A*y<ε/2 := by have h:= (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0<2*A)).mp hy1; nlinarith
have hcu : C*u≤A := by dsimp [A]; nlinarith [mul_nonneg hC hv]
have hcv : C*(v+1)≤A := by dsimp [A]; nlinarith [mul_nonneg hC hu]

have hcx : C*x*(v+1)≤A*x := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcv hx]
have hcy : C*u*y≤A*y := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcu hy
linarith"}));text({candidate:r.candidate,accepted:r.accepted,helper:r.helper,diagnostic:r.accepted?undefined:r.stdout.slice(-5000)});

  intro s r c U G hc hU f hf hgf
  have hUf:=hU f hf hgf

  refine ⟨(hscale (c f) (U f) hUf.1).1, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hspec⟩ := @yui_aux_0023 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 1 ‖c f‖ (hn r (U f)) ε (by norm_num) (norm_nonneg _) (hn0 _) hε
  obtain ⟨η,hη,hηspec⟩:=hc f hf hgf δ hδ
  obtain ⟨ζ,hζ,hζspec⟩:=hUf.2 δ hδ
  refine ⟨min η ζ,lt_min hη hζ,?_⟩
  intro g hg hgg hd
  have hUg:=(hU g hg hgg).1
  have hUd:=(hsub _ _ hUg hUf.1).1
  have hc':=hηspec g hg hgg (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_left _ _))
  have hu':=hζspec g hg hgg (lt_of_lt_of_le hd (min_le_right _ _))

  rw [he]
  have hsum:=(hadd _ _ (hscale (c g-c f) _ hUg).1 (hscale (c f) _ hUd).1).2
  rw [(hscale (c g-c f) _ hUg).2,(hscale (c f) _ hUd).2] at hsum
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt hsum
  have hb:=(hadd (U f) (U g-U f) hUf.1 hUd).2
  have hb' : hn r (U g)≤hn r (U f)+hn r (U g-U f) := by simpa only [add_sub_cancel] using hb
  simpa only [one_mul] using hspec _ _ _ (norm_nonneg _) (hn0 _) (hn0 _) hc' hu' hb')

const r=JSON.parse(await tools.check_auxiliary({statement:"open KdVPlan in (∀ τ : ℝ, ∀ f : Coeff, RealField f → RealField (Ftau τ f) ∧ RealField (Htau τ f) ∧ RealField (psi τ f)) ∧ (∀ τ : ℝ, ∀ f : Coeff, ZeroMean (Ftau τ f) ∧ ZeroMean (Htau τ f) ∧ (ZeroMean f → ZeroMean (psi τ f)))",proof:"exact (open KdVPlan in by
  have ops:=@yui_aux_0034 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hS:=ops.1
  have hI:=ops.2.1
  have hP:=ops.2.2.1
  have hA : ∀ f g, RealField f → RealField g → RealField (f+g) := fun f g hf hg=>(ops.2.2.2.1 f g hf hg).1
  have hSub : ∀ f g, RealField f → RealField g → RealField (f-g) := fun f g hf hg=>(ops.2.2.2.1 f g hf hg).2
  have hscale:=ops.2.2.2.2
  have hm:=@yui_aux_0035 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  constructor
  · intro τ f hf
    have hr : star (mul f f 0)=mul f f 0 := by have hh:=hm f f hf hf 0; simpa using hh.symm
    have hF : RealField (Ftau τ f) := by
      unfold Ftau
      apply hSub
      · apply hscale _ (by simp); apply hP; apply hm <;> apply hS <;> apply hI <;> exact hf
      · apply hscale _ (by simp); apply hS; apply hP; apply hm <;> apply hI <;> exact hf
    have hH : RealField (Htau τ f) := by
      unfold Htau
      apply hSub
      · apply hSub
        · apply hA
          · apply hscale _ (by simp); apply hP; apply hm
            · exact hS τ _ (hI f hf)
            · exact hI _ hF

  intro m f
  have he : (fun k : ℤ=>weight ((m:ℝ)+1) k*‖f k‖^2)=(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖f k‖^2)+(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖(k:ℂ)*f k‖^2) := by

    have hw : ∀ k : ℤ, 0≤weight (m:ℝ) k := fun k=>Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _

    have hf' : Summable (fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖f k‖^2) := Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k=>mul_nonneg (hw k) (sq_nonneg _)) (fun k=>by change _ ≤ _+_; exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (hw k) (sq_nonneg _))) hf

  intro f
  have normdiff:=@yui_aux_0055 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 1
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u,hu,he⟩
    refine ⟨fun t=>he t ▸ (normdiff (u t) (u t)).1,?_⟩
    intro t ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hspec⟩:=(Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hu.continuousAt) ε hε
    refine ⟨δ,hδ,?_⟩
    intro r hdr
    rw [← he r,← he t,(normdiff (u r) (u t)).2]
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm,Real.norm_eq_abs] using hspec (by simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hdr)
  · rintro ⟨hm,hc⟩
    obtain ⟨Q,hQ⟩:=(@yui_aux_0046 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.2
    refine ⟨fun t=>Q (f t),?_,fun t=>hQ (f t) (hm t)⟩
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
    intro t
    apply Metric.continuousAt_iff.mpr
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hspec⟩:=hc t ε hε
    refine ⟨δ,hδ,?_⟩
    intro r hdr
    have hd : hn 1 (f r-f t)=‖Q (f r)-Q (f t)‖ := by rw [← hQ (f r) (hm r),← hQ (f t) (hm t)]; exact (normdiff _ _).2
    rw [dist_eq_norm,← hd]
    exact hspec r (by simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using hdr))"}));text({candidate:r.candidate,accepted:r.accepted,helper:r.helper});if(!r.accepted){const d=JSON.parse(await tools.read_lean_draft({kind:"auxiliary",candidate:r.candidate,start:1,end:110}));text(d.actual_check.stdout.slice(d.actual_check.stdout.indexOf("error")));store("contlift",d)}

content.text:
### Task and constraints

Prove the fixed local target `KdVPlan.SchemeOutput` from:

```lean
T gamma R : ℝ
h_E006 : KdVPlan.Endpoint
h_T005 : KdVPlan.BilinearOutput
h_T013 : KdVPlan.SobolevInfrastructure
```

Follow supplied NL route: continuity and preservation of explicit unfiltered update; E006 endpoint identity; glue explicit floor-index interpolation. **Only submit the final tactic body via `submit_transition` when complete.** No accepted target yet.

Use only provided Lean tools/Mathlib. Helpers are checked theorems, not premises. After reset, query `read_lean_draft` index. Every registered helper application starts:

```lean
@yui_aux_XXXX T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
```

The local checking namespace is root, so conveniently write auxiliary statements as `open KdVPlan in ...` and tactic bodies as:

```lean
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  ...)
```

Tool results are JSON **strings**; parse with `JSON.parse`. `check_auxiliary` stdout can truncate before errors because accumulated helper linter warnings. On failure, read that candidate using `read_lean_draft`; its `actual_check.stdout` contains full diagnostics. Do not mistake truncation for absence of errors.

### Progress

**Everything in `SchemeOutput` except the final interpolant’s `Piecewise` assertion has been established in checked helpers.** Specifically:

- `Ftau : H⁰ → H¹` continuous.
- All four exact terms of `Htau : H⁰ → H¹` continuous, including fixed scalar `1/τ`.
- `psi` and every finite numerical iterate continuous on all H⁰ inputs.
- Reality, zero mean, H⁰ membership preserved.
- Spatial smoothness preserved by convolution, updates and finite trajectories.
- Both actual `Vst` endpoint equalities.
- Exact floor-grid identity for interpolant.
- Interpolant `RealPath` on any interval.

No mathematical/source inconsistency was found. An earlier request for local implementation advice through `report_proof_obstruction` returned `{"accepted":false,"error":"'packet'"}`. This did not end the stage.

Most recent commentary:
> “The update and every finite trajectory now check for continuity, regularity, reality, zero mean, and spatial smoothness. Both interpolation endpoint identities and its real, mean-zero property also check. The remaining obligation is `Piecewise`: smoothness in time within each grid interval and Sobolev continuity across the joins.”

### Main assembly helpers

Use these to assemble all completed target clauses:

- **`yui_aux_0025`**
  ```lean
  ∀ τ : ℝ, ContinuousMapH 0 1 (Ftau τ) (fun _ => True)
  ```

- **`yui_aux_0032`**
  ```lean
  (∀ τ, ContinuousMapH 0 0 (psi τ) (fun _ => True)) ∧
  (∀ τ n, ContinuousMapH 0 0 (fun f => numerical τ f n) (fun _ => True))
  ```

- **`yui_aux_0019`.2** restricts a continuous map’s guard:
  ```lean
  ∀ s r A G H,
    ContinuousMapH s r A G →
    (∀ f, H f → G f) →
    ContinuousMapH s r A H
  ```
  Hence restrict the above `True` guards to `ZeroMean`, or `ZeroMean ∧ RealField`.

- **`yui_aux_0037`**
  ```lean
  (∀ s t f, Data s f → Data s (S t f)) ∧
  (∀ t f, Smooth f → Smooth (S t f)) ∧
  (∀ τ f, Data 0 f → Data 0 (psi τ f)) ∧
  (∀ τ f, Data 0 f → ∀ n,
    Data 0 (numerical τ f n) ∧ Data 0 (twistedNum τ f n))
  ```

- **`yui_aux_0044`**
  ```lean
  (∀ τ f, Smooth f →
    Smooth (Ftau τ f) ∧ Smooth (Htau τ f) ∧ Smooth (psi τ f)) ∧
  (∀ τ f, Smooth f → ∀ n,
    Smooth (numerical τ f n) ∧ Smooth (twistedNum τ f n))
  ```

- **`yui_aux_0045`** is exactly SchemeOutput’s third conjunct:
  ```lean
  ∀ τ f n, 0 < τ → Data 0 f → Smooth f →
    Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ (twistedNum τ f n) ((n:ℝ)*τ)
      = twistedNum τ f n ∧
    Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ (twistedNum τ f n) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ)
      = twistedNum τ f (n+1)
  ```

- **`yui_aux_0050`.2**
  ```lean
  ∀ τ, 0 < τ → ∀ f, Data 0 f → Smooth f →
    ∀ H, RealPath 0 H (interp τ f)
  ```

- **`yui_aux_0011`**
  ```lean
  (∀ τ, 0 < τ → ∀ n, gridIndex τ ((n:ℝ)*τ)=n) ∧
  (∀ τ, 0 < τ → ∀ f n,
    interp τ f ((n:ℝ)*τ)=twistedNum τ f n) ∧
  (∀ τ f n, numerical τ f (n+1)=psi τ (numerical τ f n))
  ```
  Exact-grid identity is unconditional on data and L.

`h_E006` directly supplies second target conjunct.

### Remaining mathematical work / planned route

Need prove:

```lean
∀ τ f L, 0 < τ → Data 0 f → Smooth f →
  Piecewise 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (interp τ f)
```

Recall:

```lean
SmoothOn a b f :=
  (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞)
      (fun t => f t k) (Icc a b)) ∧
  ∀ m j : ℕ,
    ContH (m:ℝ) a b
      (fun t k => iteratedDerivWithin j (fun r => f r k) (Icc a b) t)

Piecewise a b f :=
  (∀ m : ℕ, ContH (m:ℝ) a b f) ∧
  ∃ p : Finset ℝ, ∀ l r,
    a ≤ l → l < r → r ≤ b →
    (∀ x ∈ p, x ∉ Ioo l r) → SmoothOn l r f
```

Promising route already being developed:

1. Use H¹ realization in `lp (fun _ : ℤ => ℂ) 2`, supplied by T013.
2. Define a **local predicate** for globally smooth rapidly decreasing coefficient paths:
   every spatial moment `fun t k => (k:ℂ)^n * f t k` has a `ContDiff ℝ C∞` lift under `FromLP 1`.
   This remains the permitted Fourier representation; lp is only infrastructure.
3. Prove closure under constants, sums, scalar smooth functions, `invD`, `P`, `dx`, time convolution/product, `S t` action, and coefficientwise integration.
4. Convert this predicate to `SmoothOn a b` for `a < b`.
5. For `Vst` on grid cells, the fixed remainder can be eliminated using E006, avoiding any direct eta/remainder estimates:
   ```lean
   rem a τ f f f =
     f + F a f (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) + Cst a f (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) -
       S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f))
   ```
   when `a=(n:ℝ)*τ`, `Data 0 f`, `Smooth f`.
   This equality was used successfully in helper0050 (candidate70). Once stages are temporally smooth, it also proves remainder spatially smooth.
6. Glue finite cells using endpoint helper0045. Partition can be finite grid values. Need handle final endpoint floor index `L`: helper0011 gives its exact value; neighboring terminal endpoint matches. Need Sobolev continuity across joins and `SmoothOn` congruence on subintervals avoiding grid breakpoints.

### Newly checked infrastructure for time regularity

These are important; **reuse rather than rebuild**.

#### `yui_aux_0046` — realization algebra and inverse choice

```lean
(∀ s, Function.Injective (FromLP s)) ∧
(∀ s (x y : lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2),
  FromLP s (x+y)=FromLP s x+FromLP s y ∧
  FromLP s (x-y)=FromLP s x-FromLP s y) ∧
(∀ s c x, FromLP s (c • x)=scale c (FromLP s x)) ∧
∃ Q : Coeff → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,
  ∀ f, MemH 1 f → FromLP 1 (Q f)=f
```

Projections: `.1` injection, `.2.1` add/sub, `.2.2.1` scale, `.2.2.2` existence Q.

#### `yui_aux_0051` — derivative criterion via separating continuous coordinates

General complete real normed space, no continuity of u needed:

```lean
∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E],
∀ (ι : Type) (ev : ι → E →L[ℝ] ℂ),
  (∀ x y, (∀ i, ev i x=ev i y) → x=y) →
∀ u du : ℝ → E,
  Continuous du →
  (∀ i t, HasDerivAt (fun r=>ev i (u r)) (ev i (du t)) t) →
  ∀ t, HasDerivAt u (du t) t
```

Proof uses coordinate FTC:
`u r = u 0 + ∫ x in 0..r, du x`, then Banach FTC.

#### `yui_aux_0052` — order conversion

```lean
∀ j : ℕ, (j:WithTop ℕ∞) < ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞)
```

Use this explicitly. `by simp` failed for this coercion. Preserve **inner top C∞**, not outer analytic top.

#### `yui_aux_0053` — smoothness from continuous lifts of all coordinate derivatives

```lean
∀ E [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E],
∀ ι (ev : ι → E →L[ℝ] ℂ),
  (∀ x y, (∀ i, ev i x=ev i y) → x=y) →
∀ φ : ι → ℝ → ℂ,
  (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (φ i)) →
∀ u : ℕ → ℝ → E,
  (∀ j, Continuous (u j)) →
  (∀ j i t, ev i (u j t)=iteratedDeriv j (φ i) t) →
  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (u 0)
```

Uses0051 to show derivative `u j = u(j+1)` and then `contDiff_of_differentiable_iteratedDeriv`.

#### `yui_aux_0054` — weighted coordinate CLMs

```lean
∃ ev : ℤ → (lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2) →L[ℝ] ℂ,
  (∀ k x, ev k x=FromLP 1 x k) ∧
  (∀ x y, (∀ k, ev k x=ev k y) → x=y)
```

Construction:
```lean
fun k =>
  (((weight (-1/2) k:ℂ) •
    lp.evalCLM ℂ (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2 k).restrictScalars ℝ)
```

#### `yui_aux_0055` — norm differences

```lean
∀ s x y,
  MemH s (FromLP s x) ∧
  hn s (FromLP s x-FromLP s y)=‖x-y‖
```

#### `yui_aux_0056` — inverse-choice norm conversion

```lean
∀ Q : Coeff → lp ... 2,
  (∀ f, MemH 1 f → FromLP 1 (Q f)=f) →
∀ f g, MemH 1 f → MemH 1 g →
  hn 1 (f-g)=‖Q f-Q g‖
```

Avoid rewriting `f` everywhere in a goal involving `Q f`: rewrites also rewrite inside Q. This helper isolates correct conversion.

#### `yui_aux_0057` — continuous lift characterization (GLOBAL times)

```lean
∀ f : Path,
  (∃ u : ℝ → lp ... 2,
    Continuous u ∧ ∀ t, FromLP 1 (u t)=f t) ↔
  (∀ t, MemH 1 (f t)) ∧
  ∀ t ε : ℝ, 0<ε →
    ∃ δ, 0<δ ∧ ∀ r, |r-t|<δ → hn 1 (f r-f t)<ε
```

This will help prove continuity of `S r (f r)`.

#### `yui_aux_0058` — strong continuity of Fourier group on fixed input

```lean
∀ s t f, MemH s f →
  Continuous (fun r : ℝ => hn s (S r f-S t f))
```

Proof uses `continuous_tsum` with summable majorant
`4 * (weight s k * ‖f k‖²)` and continuous sqrt.

**Immediate next useful lemma:** continuous H¹ lift of f implies continuous H¹ lift of `fun r => S r (f r)`. Use0057 and decomposition:

```lean
S r (f r)-S t (f t) =
  S r (f r-f t)+(S r (f t)-S t (f t))
```

Triangle, S isometry, epsilon/2. For the second term use0058 at fixed `f t`; its value at r=t is zero. `Metric.continuousAt_iff` supplies δ. This does **not** require extra moments.

For temporal smoothness of S action, each coefficient is exp times scalar smooth; iterated derivatives are finite Leibniz sums of frequency moments. Use continuous-lift closure above on those terms, then0053 to conclude smoothness of each spatial-moment lift. This avoids proving an unbounded generator differentiable in Banach norm directly.

#### `yui_aux_0059` — actual convolution bilinearity

```lean
(∀ f f' g, MemH 0 f → MemH 0 f' → MemH 0 g →
  mul (f+f') g=mul f g+mul f' g) ∧
(∀ f g g', MemH 0 f → MemH 0 g → MemH 0 g' →
  mul f (g+g')=mul f g+mul f g') ∧
(∀ c f g,
  mul (scale c f) g=scale c (mul f g) ∧
  mul f (scale c g)=scale c (mul f g))
```

#### **Latest helper `yui_aux_0060`** — continuous bilinear H¹ convolution on lp

```lean
∃ B :
  (lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2) →L[ℝ]
  (lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2) →L[ℝ]
  (lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2),
  ∀ x y,
    FromLP 1 (B x y)=mul (FromLP 1 x) (FromLP 1 y)
```

**Candidate82, accepted.** Built using Q from0046, H¹ algebra bound0017, injectivity and0059, `LinearMap.mk₂ ℂ`, `mkContinuous₂`, and `.bilinearRestrictScalars ℝ`. This should allow Banach `ContDiff` calculus for product paths.

### Other checked helper inventory

open KdVPlan in ∀ f : Path,
 (∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2, Continuous u ∧ ∀ t, FromLP 1 (u t)=f t) →
 ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2, Continuous u ∧ ∀ t, FromLP 1 (u t)=S t (f t)
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro f hf
  have hc:=(@yui_aux_0057 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 f).mp hf
  apply (@yui_aux_0057 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _).mpr
  refine ⟨fun t=>(@yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 1 t (f t) (hc.1 t) |>.1,?_⟩
  intro t ε hε
  obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩:=hc.2 t (ε/2) (by linarith)
  have hs:=@yui_aux_0058 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 1 t (f t) (hc.1 t)
  obtain ⟨η,hη,he⟩:=(Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hs.continuousAt) (ε/2) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨min δ η,lt_min hδ hη,?_⟩
  intro r hr
  have h1:=hd r (lt_of_lt_of_le hr (min_le_left _ _))
  have h2:=he (x:=r) (by simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using lt_of_lt_of_le hr (min_le_right _ _))
  have hz: hn 1 (S t (f t)-S t (f t))=0:=by
    simpa using (@yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 1).2
  rw [hz,dist_eq_norm,sub_zero,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg ((@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 1).1 _)] at h2
  have hm:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 1).2.2.1 (f r) (f t) (hc.1 r) (hc.1 t)
  have hsm:=(@yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 1 r (f r-f t) hm.1
  have ht:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 1).2.2.1
    (S r (f t)) (S t (f t))
    ((@yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 1 r (f t) (hc.1 t)).1
    ((@yui_aux_0008 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 1 t (f t) (hc.1 t)).1
  have ha:=(@yui_aux_0002 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 1 _ _ hsm.1 ht.1).2
  rw [(@yui_aux_0016 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.1] at ha
  have eqn : S r (f r)-S r (f t)+(S r (f t)-S t (f t))=S r (f r)-S t (f t):=by abel
  rw [eqn,← (@yui_aux_0016 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.1,hsm.2] at ha
  linarith)

∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E],
 ∀ (L : E →L[ℝ] ℂ) (u : ℝ → E), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u →
 ∀ j t, L (iteratedDeriv j u t)=iteratedDeriv j (fun r=>L (u r)) t
arguments.proof:
intro E _ _ L u hu j
induction j with
| zero => intro t; rfl
| succ j hj =>
  intro t
  have hd : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedDeriv j u):=
    hu.differentiable_iteratedDeriv j (@yui_aux_0052 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 j)
  have eqn : (fun r=>L (iteratedDeriv j u r))=iteratedDeriv j (fun r=>L (u r)):=funext hj
  rw [iteratedDeriv_succ,iteratedDeriv_succ,← eqn]
  exact (L.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hd t).hasDerivAt).deriv.symm

exact (open KdVPlan in by
  dsimp only
  let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k
  have hc : ∀ f, Smooth f → Reg (fun _=>f):=by
    intro f hf n
    have hm:=(@yui_aux_0040 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ ((@yui_aux_0039 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1 f hf n)).2
    obtain ⟨u,hu⟩:= (h_T013.1 1 _).mp hm
    refine ⟨fun _=>u,contDiff_const,?_⟩
    intro t k
    exact congrFun hu.symm k
  have ha : ∀ f g, Reg f → Reg g →
      Reg (fun t=>f t+g t) ∧ Reg (fun t=>f t-g t):=by
    intro f g hf hg
    constructor
    · intro n
      obtain ⟨u,hu,he⟩:=hf n
      obtain ⟨v,hv,hvE⟩:=hg n
      refine ⟨fun t=>u t+v t,hu.add hv,?_⟩
      intro t k
      rw [(@yui_aux_0046 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1 1 _ _ |>.1]
      change FromLP 1 (u t) k+FromLP 1 (v t) k=_
      rw [he,hvE]
      exact (mul_add _ _ _).symm
    · intro n
      obtain ⟨u,hu,he⟩:=hf n
      obtain ⟨v,hv,hvE⟩:=hg n
      refine ⟨fun t=>u t-v t,hu.sub hv,?_⟩
      intro t k
      rw [(@yui_aux_0046 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1 1 _ _ |>.2]
      change FromLP 1 (u t) k-FromLP 1 (v t) k=_
      rw [he,hvE]
      exact (mul_sub _ _ _).symm
  have hs : ∀ c : ℝ → ℂ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) c →
      ∀ f, Reg f → Reg (fun t=>scale (c t) (f t)):=by

  have hh : ∀ f, Reg f → ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t=>f t k):=by

313:   ext x

316:   simp [derivWithin_univ]

open KdVPlan in ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ f : Coeff,
 MemH (m:ℝ) f → MemH (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k) →
 HB ((m:ℝ)+1) f (hn (m:ℝ) f+hn (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k))
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro m f hf hd
  refine ⟨(@yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 m f).mp ⟨hf,hd⟩,?_⟩
  have he : (fun k : ℤ=>weight ((m:ℝ)+1) k*‖f k‖^2)=(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖f k‖^2)+(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖(k:ℂ)*f k‖^2) := by
    funext k
    simp only [weight,Real.rpow_add (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<1+(k:ℝ)^2),Real.rpow_one,norm_mul,mul_pow,Pi.add_apply]
    have hn : ‖(k:ℂ)‖^2=(k:ℝ)^2 := by simp [Complex.norm_intCast,sq_abs]
    rw [hn]
    ring
  have hs : ∀ (s : ℝ) (g : Coeff), (hn s g)^2=∑' k, weight s k*‖g k‖^2:=by
    intro s g
    exact @yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ (fun k=>mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _))
  have heq : (hn ((m:ℝ)+1) f)^2=(hn (m:ℝ) f)^2+(hn (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k))^2:=by
    rw [hs,hs,hs,he,hf.tsum_add hd]
  have h1:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 f
  have h2:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k)
  have h3:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 ((m:ℝ)+1)).1 f
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1 h2])

open KdVPlan in ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ f : Coeff,
 MemH (m:ℝ) f → MemH (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k) →
 HB ((m:ℝ)+1) f (hn (m:ℝ) f+hn (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k))
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro m f hf hd
  refine ⟨(@yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 m f).mp ⟨hf,hd⟩,?_⟩
  have he : (fun k : ℤ=>weight ((m:ℝ)+1) k*‖f k‖^2)=(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖f k‖^2)+(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖(k:ℂ)*f k‖^2) := by
    funext k
    simp only [weight,Real.rpow_add (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<1+(k:ℝ)^2),Real.rpow_one,norm_mul,mul_pow,Pi.add_apply]
    have hn : ‖(k:ℂ)‖^2=(k:ℝ)^2 := by simp [Complex.norm_intCast,sq_abs]
    rw [hn]
    ring
  have hs : ∀ (s : ℝ) (g : Coeff), (hn s g)^2=∑' k, weight s k*‖g k‖^2:=by
    intro s g
    exact @yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ (fun k=>mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _))
  have heq : (hn ((m:ℝ)+1) f)^2=(hn (m:ℝ) f)^2+(hn (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k))^2:=by
    rw [hs,hs,hs,he]
    exact hf.tsum_add hd
  have h1:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 f
  have h2:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k)
  have h3:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 ((m:ℝ)+1)).1 f
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1 h2])

 MemH (m:ℝ) f → MemH (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k) →

  refine ⟨(@yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 m f).mp ⟨hf,hd⟩,?_⟩
  have he : (fun k : ℤ=>weight ((m:ℝ)+1) k*‖f k‖^2)=(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖f k‖^2)+(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖(k:ℂ)*f k‖^2) := by
    funext k
    simp only [weight,Real.rpow_add (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<1+(k:ℝ)^2),Real.rpow_one,norm_mul,mul_pow,Pi.add_apply]
    have hn : ‖(k:ℂ)‖^2=(k:ℝ)^2 := by simp [Complex.norm_intCast,sq_abs]
    rw [hn]
    ring
  have hs : ∀ (s : ℝ) (g : Coeff), (hn s g)^2=∑' k, weight s k*‖g k‖^2:=by
    intro s g
    exact @yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ (fun k=>mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _))
  have heq : (hn ((m:ℝ)+1) f)^2=(hn (m:ℝ) f)^2+(hn (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k))^2:=by
    rw [hs,hs,hs,he]
    exact hf.tsum_add hd
  have h1:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 f
  have h2:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k)
  have h3:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 ((m:ℝ)+1)).1 f

  dsimp only

  have basic:=@yui_aux_0064 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hc : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ f, Reg f → ∀ a b : ℝ, ContH (m:ℝ) a b f:=by
    intro m

      intro f hf a b

      have hh:=(@yui_aux_0057 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 f).mp ⟨u,hu.continuous,hue⟩
      refine ⟨fun t ht=>(h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 1 _ (by norm_num) (hh.1 t)).1,?_⟩
      intro t ht ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩:=hh.2 t ε hε

      intro r hr hdr
      have hm:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 1).2.2.1 _ _ (hh.1 r) (hh.1 t)
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 1 _ (by norm_num) hm.1).2 (hd r hdr)

      intro f hf a b

      refine ⟨fun t ht=>basic.2.2.2.2 f hf t (m+1),?_⟩
      intro t ht ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩:=hfc.2 t ht (ε/2) (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨η,hη,he⟩:=hdc.2 t ht (ε/2) (by linarith)
      refine ⟨min δ η,lt_min hδ hη,?_⟩
      intro r hr hdr
      have h1:=hd r hr (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_left _ _))
      have h2:=he r hr (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_right _ _))
      have hm:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).2.2.1 _ _ (hfc.1 r hr) (hfc.1 t ht)
      have hdm:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).2.2.1 _ _ (hdc.1 r hr) (hdc.1 t ht)
      have eqn : (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*(f r-f t) k)=(fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f r k)-(fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f t k):=by funext k; exact mul_sub _ _ _
      have hb:=(@yui_aux_0072 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 m _ hm.1 (eqn ▸ hdm.1)).2
      rw [eqn] at hb
      simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
      linarith
  refine ⟨fun f hf m=>hc m f hf,?_⟩
  intro f hf a b hab
  have hcoord:=(@yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 f hf
  refine ⟨fun k=>(hcoord k).contDiffOn,?_⟩
  intro m j

open KdVPlan in ∀ τ : ℝ, 0<τ → ∀ f : Coeff, Data 0 f → Smooth f →
 (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ),
  interp τ f t=Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ (twistedNum τ f n) t) ∧
 ∀ L : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, ContH (m:ℝ) 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (interp τ f)
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro τ hτ f hf hfs
  have heq : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ),
      interp τ f t=Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ (twistedNum τ f n) t:=by
    intro n t ht
    by_cases he : t=((n:ℝ)+1)*τ
    · subst t
      rw [← Nat.cast_one (R:=ℝ),← Nat.cast_add,(@yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1 τ hτ]
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using ((@yui_aux_0045 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 τ f n hτ hf hfs).2).symm
    · have ht0 : 0≤t:=le_trans (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) hτ.le) ht.1
      have hi : gridIndex τ t=n:=by
        apply (Nat.floor_eq_iff (div_nonneg ht0 hτ.le)).mpr
        exact ⟨(le_div_iff₀ hτ).mpr ht.1,(div_lt_iff₀ hτ).mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 he)⟩
      simp only [interp,hi]
  have hc : ∀ n m : ℕ, ContH (m:ℝ) ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (interp τ f):=by
    intro n m
    have hd:=(@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.2 τ f hf n |>.2
    have hs:=(@yui_aux_0044 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 τ f hfs n |>.2
    have hreg:=(@yui_aux_0071 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2 τ hτ n _ hd hs
    exact @yui_aux_0073 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ _ _ _ _
      ((@yui_aux_0074 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 _ hreg m _ _) (heq n)
  refine ⟨heq,?_⟩
  intro L
  induction L with
  | zero =>
    intro m
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero,zero_mul]
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      have he : t=0:=by simpa using le_antisymm ht.2 ht.1
      subst t
      have hh:=(hc 0 m).1 0 (by simp; exact hτ.le)
      simpa using hh
    · intro t ht ε hε
      refine ⟨1,by norm_num,?_⟩
      intro r hr hdr
      have ht0 : t=0:=by simpa using le_antisymm ht.2 ht.1
      have hr0 : r=0:=by simpa using le_antisymm hr.2 hr.1
      rw [ht0,hr0,sub_self,(@yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _).2]
      exact hε
  | succ L ih =>
    intro m
    have hh:=(hc L m)
    have h := (@yui_aux_0075 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 (m:ℝ) 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (((L:ℝ)+1)*τ)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg L) hτ.le) (by nlinarith) _ (ih m) hh
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using h)
